Last updated November 10, 2026. This update corrects which sign-in methods administrators can use to confirm sensitive changes and adds the section on text messages. It adds no new obligations for you.

These terms cover your use of neon1.tech and the 1NEON client portal, which are run by neon1 LLC ("neon1", "I", "me"). Paid work is governed by a separate agreement or signed proposal. If that agreement conflicts with these terms, the agreement wins.

1. The website

neon1.tech describes neon1's services. The information is general and isn't professional advice for your situation until we've agreed on the work.

2. The 1NEON portal

1NEON is where neon1 and its clients plan, run, measure, and hand over projects. Access is by invitation only.

  • Your account. Sign in with a code sent to your email, or with a passkey. Admin actions (inviting people, changing access or settings, and deleting a project or someone else's comment or file) also need a recent confirmation with a passkey, an authenticator app, or a text-message code. Keep your sign-in methods secure and don't share your account. Tell me right away at the address below if you think someone else has used it.
  • Your organization. Your organization's administrators decide who can access its workspace and at what level, and they're responsible for the people they invite.
  • Your content. You and your organization own what you put in the portal. You give neon1 permission to store, process, and display it only to provide the portal and the work we've agreed on. You confirm that you have the right to share it.
  • Acceptable use. Don't put passwords, keys, or other secrets in the portal. Don't upload malware, unlawful material, or regulated data (such as health or payment card data) unless we have a written agreement that covers it. Don't try to access another organization's data, test the portal's security without written permission, or disrupt the service.
  • Text messages. Texts are optional and only sent after you agree to them in your profile. 1NEON texts you about the changes you choose; frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out or HELP for help. Carriers aren't liable for delayed or undelivered messages.
  • Approvals. When someone approves an option, decision, change request, or handoff in the portal, the approval is recorded with their name and the time. Both sides may rely on those records as confirmation of what was agreed.

3. Availability and changes

I work to keep the portal available and secure, but it's provided "as is" and may sometimes be unavailable for maintenance or reasons beyond my control. I may improve or change the portal. If a change materially reduces what you can do, I'll tell you first. Any service levels are set out in your project or care agreement.

4. Ending access

Your organization can stop using 1NEON at any time and ask for an export of its data. I may suspend an account that breaks these terms or puts others at risk, and I'll tell you why unless the law or a security reason prevents it. Data is retained and deleted as described in the privacy policy.

5. Liability

To the extent the law allows:

  • neon1 isn't liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential losses, such as lost profits or lost data, arising from use of the website or portal.
  • neon1's total liability relating to the portal is limited to the fees your organization paid neon1 in the 12 months before the claim.

Nothing in these terms limits liability that can't be limited by law.

6. General

New York law governs these terms, and disputes go to the state or federal courts in New York County, New York. If part of these terms is unenforceable, the rest still applies. I'll post updates here and email portal users about material changes before they take effect.
